title: Israel's Sin and Captivity

questions.question: Israel is a luxuriant vine that yields its what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:1 (ESV): "Israel is a luxuriant vine that yields its fruit."

questions.question: The more his fruit increased, the more he increased his what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:1 (ESV): "The more his fruit increased, the more he increased his altars;"

questions.question: Their heart is false; now they must bear their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:2 (ESV): "Their heart is false; now they must bear their guilt."

questions.question: Sow for yourselves righteousness; reap steadfast love; break up your what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:12 (ESV): "break up your fallow ground, for it is the time to seek the Lord,"

questions.question: You have plowed iniquity; you have reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:13 (ESV): "you have reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies."

questions.question: For now they will say: "We have no king, for we do not fear the Lord; and a king, what could he do for us?"
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:3 (ESV): "For now they will say: 'We have no king...'"

questions.question: They utter mere words; with empty oaths they make covenants; so judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:4 (ESV): "so judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field."

questions.question: The inhabitants of Samaria tremble for the calf of where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:5 (ESV): "The inhabitants of Samaria tremble for the calf of Beth-aven."

questions.question: The high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed. Thorn and thistle shall grow up on their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:8 (ESV): "Thorn and thistle shall grow up on their altars,"

questions.question: From the days of where, you have sinned, O Israel?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:9 (ESV): "From the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel;"

questions.question: Samaria's king shall perish like a what on the face of the waters?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:7 (ESV): "Samaria's king shall perish like a twig on the face of the waters."

questions.question: And they shall say to the mountains, "Cover us," and to the hills, "Fall on us."
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:8 (ESV): "and they shall say to the mountains, 'Cover us,' and to the hills, 'Fall on us.'"

questions.question: Ephraim was a trained calf that loved to what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:11 (ESV): "Ephraim was a trained calf that loved to thresh,"

questions.question: I will put a yoke on her fair neck; I will drive Ephraim; Judah must plow; Jacob must harrow for himself.
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:11 (ESV): "I will drive Ephraim; Judah must plow; Jacob must harrow for himself."

questions.question: Therefore the tumult of war shall arise among your people, and all your fortresses shall be destroyed, as who destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle?
questions.explanation: Hosea 10:14 (ESV): "as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle;"

key_verse_text: Sow for yourselves righteousness; reap steadfast love; break up your fallow ground, for it is the time to seek the Lord, that he may come and rain righteousness upon you.
